commits.summary: Aligned Service Operations Live Core with production schema and wired create/update status transition logging.
Added static verifier for V28.6 Batch A Service Operations/Public/RBAC checks.
Hardened Global Search with role-scoped search_all_records RPC access and production invoice/job fields.
Extended Batch A verifier to include Global Search RBAC and production-field checks.
Added controlled NANOFIX/Supabase Storage attachment URL validation helper.
Enforced Customer Portal attachment Storage validation and rejected untrusted external attachment URLs with audit logging.
Extended Batch A verifier to cover the Customer Portal Storage attachment guard.
Fixed TypeScript strict-null build gate by narrowing Service Operations object IDs with a UUID type guard.
Restored the existing Phase D.4 warranty claim workflow verifier marker without changing business behavior.
Updated the Batch A JSON report after the Ready preview.
Updated the Batch A Markdown report after the Ready preview.
Extended Batch A verifier to cover Customer Portal Activity Timeline ownership, production fields, audit marker and timeline/payment summary response markers; latest Vercel Preview is Ready.

key_repairs: Service Operations Live Core selectors now match the V28.5/production schema alignment used by the full-chain API.
Quotation fields now use version, total_amount, currency and status instead of current_version, total and approval_status.
Invoice fields now use customer_id, job_id, quotation_id, total_amount, currency, status and visible_to_customer.
Payment fields now use invoice_id, customer_id, amount, currency, status and reconciled_at, avoiding deprecated fee usage.
Warranty fields now use starts_on and ends_on, and include customer_id, invoice_id, quotation_id, visible_to_customer and public_ref.
Status transition logs are attempted for Service Operations create paths through writeStatusTransitionLog.
Status transition logs are attempted for Service Operations update paths when the module status column changes.
Audit logs now record status_transition_logged for create/update actions, avoiding assumed success.
Global Search now role-gates search_all_records RPC to sensitive business roles only.
Global Search fallback results are split between sensitive business roles and content/operations roles.
Global Search invoice fallback now uses total_amount and currency instead of deprecated total.
Global Search job fallback now uses notes instead of deprecated completion_notes.
Global Search audit logs now include role, rpc_allowed, result counts and request IP.
Customer Portal service request attachments are normalized and validated against NANOFIX/Supabase Storage URL rules before DB write.
Untrusted Customer Portal attachment URLs are rejected with HTTP 400 and audit_logs entries instead of fake success.
Customer Portal warranty claim request type marker required by Phase D.4 verifier is preserved.
Batch A verifier now covers Customer Portal Activity Timeline ownership and production-field response markers.

public_rbac_foundation_review.public_submit_route: app/api/service-requests/route.ts already writes unified_intake, leads and service_requests and fails explicitly when Supabase is not configured.
public_rbac_foundation_review.global_search_route: app/api/global-search/route.ts now restricts full search_all_records RPC to super_admin, operations_admin, finance and support, while content roles receive scoped fallback results only.
public_rbac_foundation_review.rbac_foundation: lib/apiSecurity.ts already resolves actor identity server-side through Supabase auth tokens, profiles/admin_profiles and default-disabled secret fallback.
public_rbac_foundation_review.attachment_storage_guard: lib/storageAttachments.ts and Customer Portal service request API now reject untrusted external attachment URLs and allow only controlled NANOFIX/Supabase Storage paths/URLs.
public_rbac_foundation_review.customer_portal_timeline_gate: tools/verify-v28-6-2-service-ops-public-rbac.mjs now checks Customer Portal Activity Timeline route markers: requireActorApi, customer-only actor guard, profile_id/customer ownership lookup, real table coverage, production fields, payment_status_summary/activity_timeline response markers and customer_portal_activity_timeline_read audit marker.
